name: parallel-inspect
description: Four agents inspect different parts of the repository simultaneously (parallel strategy, widest concurrency)

agents.instructions: Use shell_exec to list the directory the task names and file_read to read its index or entry file. Report the layout in at most 6 bullet points.
Use file_read on the type definitions the task names. Report the main types and what they represent, at most 6 bullet points.
Use shell_exec to list test files and file_read to read one. Report what is tested, at most 6 bullet points.
Use file_read on the README or docs files the task names. Report what the documentation claims, at most 6 bullet points, and note anything that looks out of date.
